title: A component can have a Variant and a Size at once
goal: Today a component holds one set of looks, so a Button can be Primary or Secondary but cannot also be Small or Large. Let a component carry two or more named variant questions (Variant and Size), with each drawing answering all of them, so an instance picks each one on its own and the original lays its drawings out as a labelled grid, the way the variants mock draws it.
notes: Prerequisite for an-instance-s-properties-match-the-variants-mock (acceptance 3: picking Secondary or Large). Model today: Sources/PhotonzCore/ComponentVariantProperty.swift, componentVariantProperties(of:) returns [] or exactly one property whose id is the componentID; drawings are ComponentVersion (ComponentVersions.swift), group.variantName / versionID / versionName in the file. The doc comment there already sketches the plan: drawings stay a flat list, each carries an answer per variant property, nearest fallback. Panel: ComponentInstanceProperties.versionRow (ComponentPanel.swift) renders one row; since 2026-10-09 it is a SegmentedControl under a small caps label (falls back to a dropdown when the words do not fit), so a second row is the same view again. Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/ui-variants.html, #segVariant / #segSize and the .pmatrix grid on the component sheet. TDD in PhotonzCore.
acceptance: The original of a component can add a second variant property (for example Size) beside Variant, and name both
An instance offers each variant property as its own row in Properties, and picking one changes only that answer, in one undo step
A combination nobody drew shows the nearest drawing that was, and never a blank
Edit Original lays the drawings out as a Variant by Size grid with the option names along its edges, as ui-variants.html draws its matrix
A file saved before this opens with its one variant property unchanged

log.note: Review before building: the mock assumes a copy can ask for a combination nobody drew; the model keeps the drawings a flat list, each drawing answers every question, and a copy remembers the combination it asked for (instanceAnswers) while showing the nearest drawing (it keeps the answer just picked). A Figma user expects per-variant property values; here typing an existing answer moves the drawing into it and a new word renames that answer everywhere, which covers both Figma moves from one field. A second question needs a first one, so New Variant Property only appears once the component has two looks.

Built: PhotonzCore ComponentVariantProperty (questions, answers, nearest drawing, copy answers), ComponentVariantGrid (grid layout and edges), Layer variantAnswers/instanceAnswers (unwritten for one-question components). Panel: a row per question on the original with answer fields, Add > Another <Question> per question and New Variant Property; a segmented row per question on a copy. Canvas: answers on plates along the grid edges on Edit Original. Tests: ComponentVariantGridTests (18). Walk: variant-and-size-walk, green with 6 real captures; 38 other component walks green.

Also fixed: the full suite failed on main since 3061dbe0 because the video kit stopped compiling on its own (VideoKitControls used the app's ComponentGlyphShape). The mark's path now lives in VideoKit.

left rough: no way to remove a second question; a copy on an undrawn combination keeps the nearest drawing after the exact one is drawn, until picked again; tutorial-component-versions-walk failed once at step 66 (focus on a new look's name field) inside a 34-walk batch and passed when run alone, so read as timing, not this change.
Filed edit-original-draws-a-two-question-component-ins (p2) for the mock's matrix panel and camera framing; default answer names fold into the-starter-button-comes-as-primary-secondary-or.

Shipped dbf55248: a component asks Variant and Size at once (New Variant Property on the original), a copy picks each on its own segmented row in one undo step, an undrawn combination shows the nearest drawing, Edit Original lays the drawings out as a labelled Variant by Size grid, and one-question files save unchanged.
